options.title: How Did Kobe Bryant's Pilot Not Feel the Turn?
options.first_line: Kobe Bryant's helicopter flew into cloud over Calabasas. How could its pilot not feel it turning?
options.first_frame: 3D, grey storm light: the white-and-blue S-76 helicopter nosing into a wall of cloud above dark hills, rotor blurring, its tail already tipping left in amber, the caption 'JAN 2020 · CALABASAS, CALIFORNIA' and the reconstruction tag.

options.title: Kobe Bryant's Helicopter: Why Did the Pilot Think He Was Climbing?
options.first_line: In thick cloud over Calabasas, Kobe Bryant's pilot said he was climbing. What was the helicopter really doing?
options.first_frame: 3D inside the cloud beside the S-76: grey all around, the helicopter's attitude indicator in a loupe already tilting left in amber, the place caption and the reconstruction tag.

options.title: The Cloud Over Calabasas That Hid Kobe Bryant's Helicopter
options.first_line: A wall of cloud over the Calabasas hills, and Kobe Bryant's helicopter climbing straight into it. Why didn't it come out?
options.first_frame: 3D wide over the brown Calabasas hills: a low cloud deck rolling over the ridge and the small S-76 climbing into it, the place caption and the reconstruction tag.

why: The pilot saying he was climbing while the helicopter did something else is a contradiction a stranger can't resolve without staying, about a name everyone knows, and the title doesn't give away what it was really doing.
